nominations.

First Class or before a Notary Public.

information to furnish in respect of any item, either "Nil" or "Not applicable",
as the case may be, should be mentioned.
The affidavit should be either typed or written legibly and neatly.
Each page of the Affidavit should be signed by the deponent and the Affidavit
should bear on each page the stamp of the Notary or Oath Commissioner or
Magistrate before whom the Affidavit is sworn.
